extracted.name: Curried Butternut Squash Soup
extracted.description: This curried butternut squash soup is rich, creamy, and perfectly spiced with curry powder for a satisfying soup full of sweet and spicy flavor.
ingredient_lines: 0.25 cup sour cream, or to taste
instruction_lines: Melt butter in a large pot over medium heat. Add onion and garlic; cook and stir until softened and browned, 7 to 10 minutes.
Stir in broth, butternut squash, curry powder, salt, cumin, and cayenne pepper; bring to a boil. Reduce the heat to low and simmer until squash is tender, about 15 minutes. Remove from the heat.
Stir in half-and-half and honey. Puree soup with an immersion blender until smooth.
Ladle soup into serving bowls and top with a sour cream dollop.
